SIKA® INJECTION-306: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Injection-306, April 2023, Version 02.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/o/sika_injection-306.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Injection-306 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.02).
1.2 Product description. Sika® Injection-306 is a very low viscous, elastic polyacrylic injection resin with a versatile and adjustable reaction time which can be used in ground water protection zones.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® Injection-306 may only be used by experienced professionals.
    - Crack and joint injection
    - Injection of SikaFuko® injection hoses to seal construction joints
    - Sealing water-bearing cracks and voids
    - Sealing all types of leaking building components in damp or water saturated ground conditions
    - Sealing leaks where there is some minor movement
    - Sealing drainage pipe joints, that are, or will be, covered with damp or water saturated soil
    - Injection repair of damaged waterproofing membranes (single and double layer systems)
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.7.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Injection-306
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Polyacrylic elastic injection resin for permanent watertight sealing
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - Function test with SikaFuko® VT 1,Wissbau,Report No.2002-094-(1A)
    - Function test with SikaFuko® Eco 1,Wissbau,Report No.2002-094-(2A)
    - Mechanical and long time stability test,FH Aachen
    - Compatibility Test with Sikaplan WP/WT Membranes,MPA,Report No.1200/550/15b
    - Reaction to fire,EN 13501-1,MPA,Report No.K- 3159/085/13-MPA BS
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 13501-1: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - EN ISO 2811-2: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Density (p.2).
    - ISO 3219: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Viscosity (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Provides a passivating environment for embedded steel reinforcement
    - Adjustable curing time between 10 and 60 minutes
    - Permanently elastic, can absorb limited movement
    - Capable of reversibly absorbing (swelling) and releasing (shrinking) moisture
    - Very low viscosity comparable to water
    - Cured Sika® Injection-306 is insoluble in water and hydrocarbons and resistant to alkalis
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: 3-part polyacylic resin
    - Viscosity: ~3 - 11 mPa·s (mixture, at +20 °C) (acc. ISO 3219)
2.6 Colour.
    | Part A (Resin) | blue – transparent liquid |
    | Accelerator | yellow – transparent liquid |
    | Hardener | white - powder |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
2.7 Density.
    | Part A (Resin) | ~1,07 g/cm³ |
    | Accelerator | ~1,08 g/cm³ |
    | Hardener | ~1,25 g/cm³ |
    Test method printed: (EN ISO 2811-2)
    Test method printed: (at +20 °C)
2.8 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Reaction to fire: Class E
2.9 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of production
    - Storage conditions: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +10 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to packaging.
2.10 Packaging. Ready to use kit:
    | Part A (Resin) | 2 × 8,0 kg |
    | Accelerator | 1 × 1,0 kg |
    | Hardener | 4 × 40 g |
    | Measuring cup | 1 piece |
    | Additional Accelerator 14 x 1 kg - used for faster reaction times. |
    | Refer to current price list for packaging variations. |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 02.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Yield: ~ 40 litres per kit
    - Gel time: 10 - 60 minutes
4.3 Mixing ratio. Table 1; Accelerator Metering Chart; Ambient Temperature and Accelerator quantity (ml)
    | Reaction | +5 °C | +15 °C | +22 °C | +30 °C | +40 °C |
    | time | (+41 °F) | (+59 °F) | (+72 °F) | (+86 °F) | (+104 °F) |
    | 10 min | 1350* | 680* | 310 | 160 |
    | 20 min | 1300 * | 340* | 230 | 130 | 50 |
    | 30 min | 840* | 230 | 140 | 70 | 30 |
    | 40 min | 640* | 160 | 90 | 50 | - |
    | 50 min | 490 | 90 | 60 | 40 | - |
    | 60 min | 370 | 60 | 30 | 30 | - |
    | Example: |
    | Ambient temperature: +15 °C (+59 °F) |
    | Required reaction time: 30 min |
    | Accelerator = 230 ml |
    | Water = 1770 ml |
    | Total volume = 2000 ml |
    | 1) When using one component pumps: Workability time (pot life) = Factor 0.8 x Reaction time (refer to metering chart) |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    The quantity in Table 1 of accelerator (A1) per 8,0 kg of resin (A), will yield ~20 litres of mixed resin. The total accelerator solution must always be 2000 ml (refer to example below).
    *Fast reaction – additional accelerator necessary.
    Note:
    2) The given data are laboratory parameters and may deviate depending on the situation and conditions on site.
4.4 Mixing - Mixing Sequence. 1. Hardener solution; Pour 10 litres of water in a clean container. Dissolve the content of 2 bags (total 80 g) of hardener powder in the water. Stir with a mixer at low speed the hardener solution thoroughly until Part B is completely dissolved. 2. Accelerator solution; Determine the required quantity of accelerator from the accelerator metering chart (Table 1). Dilute the selected quantity of accelerator with water to a total quantity of 2 litres accelerator solution. 3. Accelerator solution with Part A resin; Pour the 2 litres of accelerator solution into 1 x 8.0 kg container of Part A and shake/mix thoroughly. 4. Resin solution with hardener solution; Depending on the type of injection pump used activate the injection resin using one of the methods below:
    - One component pump: Pour a partial amount of the final pre-mixed solution in the ratio of 1:1 by volume into a clean mixing container. Mix thoroughly and pour into the storage container of the pump.
    - Two component pump: Pour the resin solution into the storage container of the pumps ‘A’ side. Pour the Hardener Solution into the storage container of the pumps ‘B’ side. Then pump at a ratio of 1:1 by volume.
4.5 Application method / tools.
    - Reference must be made to further documentation where applicable, such as relevant method statement, application manual and installation or working instructions.
    - Sika® Injection-306 can be used with standard one or two component injection pumps. Stainless steel injection pumps are recommended.
4.6 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and application equipment according to the Product Data Sheet for the Sika® Injection Cleaning System.
4.7 Limitations and important considerations.
    - The conditions and location of the site the application must be inspected and surveyed, including any foundations and ground conditions, before making any new watertight sealing surfaces (curtain injection) in close proximity to buildings or within existing structures. It must also be ensured that there are no drainage systems or open pipes close to the injection areas.
    - Protect Sika® Injection-306 Part A from UV, mix the Sika® Injection-306 accelerator solution into the UVprotected bucket of Sika® Injection-306 Part A.
    - Reaction time of the final mixed material on site must be checked prior to any injection.
    - Contact Sika technical services for specific information on resistance to hydrocarbons or chemicals.
4.8 Further information. Clean all tools and application equipment in accordance with the Product Data Sheet for the ‘Sika® Injection Cleaning System’.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. +5 °C min. / +40 °C max
5.3 Substrate temperature. +5 °C min. / +40 °C max.
5.4 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Compatibility Test with Sikaplan WP/WT Membranes,MPA,Report No.1200/550/15b
5.5 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Density: Part A (Resin) | ~1,07 g/cm³; Accelerator | ~1,08 g/cm³; Hardener | ~1,25 g/cm³ (EN ISO 2811-2) (at +20 °C)
    - Viscosity: ~3 - 11 mPa·s (mixture, at +20 °C) (acc. ISO 3219)
5.6 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.7 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Injection-306, April 2023, Version 02.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/o/sika_injection-306.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® Injection-306 Hardener Powder, version 10/09/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/sds-sika-injection-306hardenerpowder.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® Injection-306 Accelerator, version 10/09/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/5/sds-sika-injection-306accelerator.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaÂ® Injection-306 Part A, https://aus.sika.com/dam/dms/au01/k/sds-sika-injection-306parta.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
